none: PAS CAM-0E69E7: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. Mint is unclear, AD 364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor with labarum dragging captive right. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows Bust right. Die axis is probably 6 o'clock, weight is 1.68g, diameter is 16.83mm
